# coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-ref-delivery-timing

<!-- Generated by tools/export_results.py. Edit only the Experiment and Observations sections. -->

## Experiment

`coop --git` (two agents with messaging and a shared git remote) with the frozen reference settings (`gemini-3.8-flash` on Vertex AI, `medium` thinking, 500 steps, compaction at 128K tokens, step counter, `$40` per-agent cost cap, `-c 4` concurrency) on the 50-pair `flash` subset, adding `delivery_timing: true` (`configs/variants/delivery_timing_medium.yaml`). Compares directly against the two `coop --git` `medium` reference baseline runs ([`coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-saturation-medium-128k-vertex`](../coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-saturation-medium-128k-vertex/summary.md) at 35/50 and [`coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-ref`](../coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-ref/summary.md) at 33/50).

## Observations

- **34/50 (68%) passed (34/50 clean-merge passes, 1 merge conflict, 0 step-limit cutoffs, 0 agent errors)** at `$109.81` (`311` min, `40` retries), matching the `34.0/50` (`68.0%`) mean of the two `coop --git` `medium` reference baseline runs (`35/50` on `coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-saturation-medium-128k-vertex` and `33/50` on `coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-ref`).
- **Against `coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-ref` (33/50)**: `+3` pair wins (`pallets_click_task/2068` (6,7), `pallets_click_task/2956` (1,8), `pillow_task/290` (3,5)) and `-2` pair losses (`pallets_click_task/2800` (2,7), `typst_task/6554` (1,9)); against `coop-msa_v2-git-gemini-3-8-flash-flash-saturation-medium-128k-vertex` (35/50): `+2` wins (`pallets_click_task/2956` (1,8), `pillow_task/290` (3,5)) and `-3` losses (`pallets_click_task/2800` (2,7), `samuelcolvin_dirty_equals_task/43` (3,7), `typst_task/6554` (1,9)). Notably, `pallets_click_task/2956` (1,8) and `pillow_task/290` (3,5) failed in both `medium` reference baseline runs and passed here.
- **49/50 pairs merged cleanly (45 clean, 4 identical branches)** with `1,442` total messages sent (median `25`/pair), `7,989` total steps (median `73`/agent), and `147` compactions — virtually identical to the `medium` reference baseline averages (`7,898` mean steps, `1,396` mean messages, `120` mean compactions).
